name: securepaysg
description: Server-side TypeScript client for the SecurePay merchant API: payments, capture, cancel, refunds and signed webhooks.
author: SecurePay team (CSIT321 group FYP-26-S4-36)

scripts.check:generated: openapi-typescript ../../contracts/generated/merchant-api.v1.json -o .generated-check.ts && node -e "const f=require('fs');const a=f.readFileSync('.generated-check.ts','utf8'),b=f.readFileSync('src/generated/openapi.ts','utf8');f.unlinkSync('.generated-check.ts');if(a!==b){console.error('src/generated/openapi.ts is out of date: run npm run generate');process.exit(1)}console.log('generated types up to date')"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check:generated && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
